name: cmu-soc
description: Query Carnegie Mellon's public Schedule of Classes: semesters, departments, sections and minis, prerequisites, registrar final exams, catalog descriptions, and campus walking times.
long_description: Unofficial. Reads CMU's public Schedule of Classes (refreshed nightly), the University Registrar's final-exam schedule and the current undergraduate catalog, on demand, for personal planning. CMU does not publish seats, waitlists, rooms or instructors publicly; those are in SIO. Final exams are only published for the current semester, around week 6. Building coordinates © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
